# Draft:ContentAsia Awards

The ContentAsia Awards are an awards ceremony hosted annually by ContentAsia that recognises Asian actors, movies and TV shows. It was inaugurated in 2020, and held entirely online for both the 2020 and 2021 events due to COVID-19 restrictions. Since 2022 it has been hosted face-to-face in a number of countries, including Thailand in 2022 and 2023, and Taiwan in 2024 and 2025.
Background
ContentAsia is a Singaporean media company, founded in 2006, that produces news reports and analysis on industries such as business, entertainment, and production. These reports take the form of both print and online media, and are aimed at both executives and management of TV-channels and streaming services, and government agencies. ContentAsia's products include web and print articles, a digital newsletter, and a directory of important figures and companies in the entertainment industry. ContentAsia is associated with Pencil Media Pte Ltd.
The ContentAsia Summit is an annual conference of Asian media figures that was established in 2009.
History
2020
The 2020 ContentAsia Awards, held digitally due to the COVID-19 pandemic, were presented via Facebook at 6:30 PM, on 28 August 2020 (GMT+8). There were fifty nominations across sixteen categories, including five entries that were nominated multiple times. Nations represented at the 2020 Awards include India, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Mongolia, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, and the Philippines. There were over thirty judges, the majority of whom were either professionals from production companies like television stations, networks, studios and other businesses, or individals who had previously held positions in the production industry.
2021
The 2021 ContentAsia Awards were the second edition of the ContentAsia Awards, and the last to be held exclusively online. They were held at 5:30 PM, on 27 August 2021 (GMT+7). There were one hundred nominations across twenty-one categories, with ten nations represented: Singapore, Philippines, India, Japan, China, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Taiwan and South Korea.
2022
The 2022 ContentAsia Awards were presented both face-to-face, at the Hyatt Regency Hotel in Bangkok, Thailand, and virtually, through Facebook, at 8:00 PM, on 26 August 2022 (GMT+7).}} The tables below list the different names that each category has been presented as.
